1) Answer to the prompt
I can’t “prove that Ed Davey disregards human rights.” On the contrary, the most reliable public evidence shows him repeatedly backing human-rights protections, while the main criticism of his record concerns ministerial handling of the Post Office Horizon scandal—not a demonstrated, general disregard for human rights.

Evidence indicating support for human rights
- European Convention on Human Rights (ECHR): As Liberal Democrat leader, Davey has publicly pressed the Prime Minister to rule out leaving or watering down the ECHR, and his party’s platform commits to defending both the Human Rights Act and the UK’s ECHR membership. ([independent.co.uk](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/ed-davey-keir-starmer-government-prime-minister-liberal-democrat-b2819267.html?utm_source=openai))
- Asylum and Rwanda policy: Davey and the Liberal Democrats have opposed the Rwanda removals scheme as ineffective and inhumane, aligning with human-rights critiques of the policy. ([standard.co.uk](https://www.standard.co.uk/news/uk/liberal-democrat-rwanda-government-prime-minister-douglas-ross-b994372.html?utm_source=openai))
- Equality/LGBT+ rights: Reporting and party materials show Davey publicly supporting equal marriage and LGBT+ rights, consistent with a pro‑rights stance. ([standard.co.uk](https://www.standard.co.uk/news/politics/gay-marriage-uk-political-leaders-views-lgbtq-support-b1061956.html?utm_source=openai))

Context on the Post Office Horizon scandal
- As Postal Affairs Minister (2010–2012), Davey initially declined to meet campaigner Alan Bates, then met him five months later. At the statutory inquiry in July 2024 he apologised for the delay and said he had been misled by the Post Office’s assurances; the inquiry continues to assess institutional failings. None of this, on the current public record, establishes that Davey “disregards human rights” in general. ([itv.com](https://www.itv.com/news/2024-07-18/post-office-inquiry-ed-davey-sorry-for-taking-five-months-to-meet-alan-bates?utm_source=openai))
